evidence.quote: In the supplied T/P status dictionary, STATUS=S denotes reported success and STATUS=F denotes reported failure. These meanings describe recorded outcomes; they do not establish that a process failure under an ultimately successful transaction is prohibited.

For this CSV review, ProcessStatusExport.TRANSACTION_ID is compared with the identical TransactionStatusExport.TRANSACTION_ID string. RETRY_COUNT is retained for provenance and is not assumed equal across files. All source CSV rows for each selected string ID are loaded.

Recovery and partial-success handling are not established by this input. A reported process failure with a successful parent may have been handled. Review of the recorded outcomes cannot prove an unrecovered failure, a protocol violation, or an incident.
